svg.title: Annex A9 · The site in the browser
svg.desc: Where it is hosted, how it loads the data and checks its consistency, its 10 views with each value's provenance and who uses it.
svg.text: Annex A9 · The site in the browser

The site is a static page, with no build step or server of its own: everything it shows comes from the data/ files of one publication. The browser checks each file belongs to that publication and, if it cannot, says so instead of mixing
Details these boxes of the full diagram: Live site (SITE_URL), Website (10 views), Public.
GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages · strict CSP
in the browser or with the open data

g.title: 1. Live site (SITE_URL) → Start-up: index.html and assets/.
2. Publication (data/) → Start-up: dashboard.json.
3. Start-up → Publication consistency: publicationId.
4. Publication (data/) → Publication consistency: each view's files. Each view requests only the files it needs, when opened.
5. Publication consistency → 10 views: consistent data.
6. Accessibility and freshness → 10 views: freshness and accessibility.
7. 10 views → Each value's provenance: each value.
8. 10 views → Data assistant: same publication.
9. 10 views → Methodology and architecture: diagrams.
10. 10 views → Map A/B analytics: map version and events. A single request when leaving the page; on GitHub Pages nothing is sent.
11. 10 views → Public: consult.
12. Publication (data/) → Open-data users: CSV y JSON.

Live site (SITE_URL). Serves index.html, assets/ and data/. By default https://pillb.github.io/observatorio-enso-peru/; with DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare, the Cloudflare Pages address. Technology: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages.

a.title: Annex A8: Publication, deployment and archive

g.title: Publication (data/). dashboard.json carries the publicationId; the other files are requested with that identifier so two publications are never mixed.
g.text: other files are requested with that identifier
so two publications are never mixed.

g.title: Map A/B analytics. Only on Cloudflare: /api/ab adds 1 per day, version (A to D) and event. No IP, cookies or identifier. Technology: Pages Functions, D1.
g.text: Only on Cloudflare: /api/ab adds 1 per day,
version (A to D) and event. No IP, cookies or

g.title: Start-up. Reads dashboard.json without cache and shows “Updated: … · Publication …”. If it cannot, it explains the data is being validated and links to ENFEN. Technology: app.js, fetch.
g.text: cannot, it explains the data is being validated

g.title: Publication consistency. If a file carries another publicationId it is requested again without cache; if still different, it is not used and a visible banner says so.

g.title: Accessibility and freshness. Keyboard, ARIA roles and light or dark theme, tested with Playwright in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox. Each value shows its period and is flagged when out of date. Technology: Playwright.
g.text: Keyboard, ARIA roles and light or dark theme,

svg.text: Steps and connections: what travels along each line, when and why
Each view requests only the files it needs, when opened.
A single request when leaving the page; on GitHub Pages nothing is sent.
If something fails: what happens and which fallback takes over
The site says so and links to the official ENFEN communiqués; it never
A file belongs to another publication (stale cache)
It is requested again; if still different, that part stays empty with a banner,
A value is out of date or carried from an earlier day
It shows its period and an out-of-date or carried mark, and the provenance
tells which copy it came from.
The official source changed or went down
The archived copy in data/archive/ shows what was read.
